$comment: HZ-135: the contract for domain/priorities.json. Validated by domain/validate.mjs — the same dependency-free Draft-07 subset validator steps.schema.json, reasons.schema.json and fields.schema.json use, so only the keywords listed in its KEYWORDS set are honoured. Rules the subset cannot express (each value matching ^[A-Z][A-Za-z]*$, case-INSENSITIVE uniqueness, and `default` being a member of `priorities`) are asserted at LOAD time by the bindings themselves — see assertPrioritiesShape() in domain/js/priorities.js and _validate_source() in domain/py/priorities.py, which domain/fixtures/priorities-cases.json drives from both sides so the two cannot drift.
title: Horizon work-item priority vocabulary

priorities.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER. It is severity, highest first, and it is display order: the intake picker renders it top-to-bottom and the WhatsApp wizard numbers it 1..n. Nothing in the repo sorts work items by priority, so there are deliberately no rank integers — a second representation of the same order would be the drift this file exists to remove.

default.$comment: What an item gets when nobody says: POST /api/items with no priority, an issue synced from GitHub carrying no priority label, and the wizard's opening session state. Must be one of `priorities` — asserted at load time, not here.
